# Utah research guide (Weber County, 1930s)

## Online records
- **U.S. federal censuses, 1940 and 1950** — indexed on FamilySearch; list each household member with relationship to the head.
- **Utah land and property records** — county recorder deeds; index online for some counties. Name grantors and grantees only.

## Offline records
- **Utah school census records, 1890s-1940s** — each school-age child listed with parent or guardian, by school district. Held by the county school districts and the Utah State Archives; not digitized or indexed online.
